title: Eight Sleep footer
description: A tall black footer: a small brand mark with a region picker and a row of white payment chips, a newsletter sign-up (title, sub-line, an underlined email field with an arrow, fine print) beside four columns of grey links under white headings, then contact details with social icons, a hairline, the copyright and a block of tiny footnotes. On phones the link columns fold into + accordions.
notes: dark-scoped black; payment marks are plain-text chips (pass your own nodes)
the phone accordions are native details/summary: no JavaScript
